release_notes: FOODEX 1.0.70: Promote the post-1.0.69 Dashboard order-notification work from Issue #1258 / PR #1259 into a new immutable FOODEX release version. Add the global Customer App new-order popup across authenticated Dashboard pages, with scoped incremental feed, queueing, session deduplication, direct order deep-linking, AR/EN support, visibility-aware polling and backoff. Preserve tenant/store/channel authorization and exclude orders created manually from Dashboard, Van or Integration sources from the Customer App popup. Synchronize repository/mobile source identities at FOODEX 1.0.70 / mobile build 1.0.70+70; the Dashboard Update ZIP remains independently deployable and does not overwrite APKs already installed on devices.
